obligations.goal: When n = 0, the sum of the first n positive odd integers is the empty sum, which equals 0 = 0².
For every nonnegative integer k, if 1 + 3 + ⋯ + (2k - 1) = k² (with the sum empty when k = 0), then 1 + 3 + ⋯ + (2k - 1) + (2k + 1) = (k + 1)².
For every nonnegative integer n, the sum of the first n positive odd integers equals n²; equivalently, 1 + 3 + ⋯ + (2n - 1) = n², with the empty sum interpreted as 0 when n = 0.
